clubs.name: FC Bayern München

ageRules.note: Requests are made under the user's own membership. Membership contract itself required a guardian signature under 18.
ageRules.standingRestriction: unknown - German youth protection may limit under-16s at events past 22:00. VERIFY.

procedure.home: Requests via tickets.fcbayern.com. Overbooked fixtures go to a members-only lottery, max 2 tickets. Overbooked home games get a Ticketmarket resale option.
procedure.away: ALL Bundesliga away fixtures for the season requested in ONE pre-season window. Once a fixture shows Overbooked the request option disappears. No away resale on the club site - post-draw waiting list only.
procedure.cup: Pokal ties open their own short window after each round's draw. NOT covered by the pre-season window, so still available this season. No member discount in the Pokal.
procedure.europe: Champions League home games requested pre-season as blind matchday slots.

clubs.demandNote: Away request volumes: Dortmund 135,000, Schalke 106,000, Köln 100,000. Least popular away fixture still drew 60,000.
clubs.openQuestion: Are away allocations weighted by prior away attendance, or a pure member lottery? Determines whether low-demand away days are strategy.

clubs.name: VfB Stuttgart

ageRules.accountHolder: self, but membership needs guardian signature under 18
ageRules.note: Under 18 joins the VfB Fritzle- und Jugendclub, not the adult e.V. Under-18 ticket reduction available; bring proof of age, required without being asked.

procedure.membership: Adult passive e.V. EUR 60/yr. Fritzle- und Jugendclub cheaper, exact fee unconfirmed.
procedure.waitingPeriod: Since 1 July 2025, new members of either body can only use the presale right after THREE MONTHS. Other benefits immediate.
procedure.home: Home matches frequently sell out in the member presale. Max 2 tickets. High-demand fixtures use an application lottery - apply within a multi-day window; timing inside it is irrelevant; random allocation after close.
procedure.pricing: Not published; visible only in the purchase flow. Member discount EUR 17 plus a separate under-18 reduction - verify whether they stack. Cheapest is standing.
procedure.warning: REWE Familienblock (75, 76, 81, 82) is restricted to Fritzle- und Jugendclub members and will be offered - but it is seated and standing is discouraged. Wrong block for atmosphere.

clubs.travel: S6 to Stuttgart Hbf, S1 to Neckarpark, approx 40 min. VVS travel normally included in the ticket.

procedure.home: Sold via ksc.de. Ordinary fixtures normally available in general sale. Derby and big-visitor fixtures sell out.
procedure.away: Away end at KSC home games is allocated by the visiting club.

clubs.name: 1. FC Kaiserslautern

procedure.home: Sold via fck.de. Ordinary fixtures usually buyable.
procedure.away: FCK away allocations run through FCK membership. Required if the target is the away end at Karlsruhe.

clubs.travelNote: Approx 3h by train vs 1h55 by car.

clubs.name: Stuttgarter Kickers

ageRules.note: Cash at the gate, no account needed.

procedure.home: Walk-up, approx EUR 12, no membership, no window, no draw. Big fixtures do sell out - the opener v SSV Ulm on 7 Aug 2026 was a full house.

clubs.role: The no-logistics option. The club to simply turn up to.

clubs.name: Politehnica Timișoara

ageRules.idAtGate: Romanian grounds check names against tickets for high-risk fixtures. Carry ID.
ageRules.note: Free entry at Tribuna 2 for under-12s and Academy juniors only. No discount at 15.

procedure.home: Bilete.ro online AND at the stadium on matchday (gates approx 90 min before). Tribuna 1 is smaller and sells out first.
procedure.seasonTicket: Tribuna 1 600 lei, Tribuna 2 350 lei - Liga 2 regular season plus Cupa României home games.

clubs.warning: 5,000 capacity. Do not plan to walk up for a Superliga opponent.
clubs.context: Boyhood club, 8 years in the academy. Newly promoted to Liga 2. At Electrica because Eroii Timișoarei is unfinished; the old Dan Păltinișanu no longer exists.

clubs.name: UTA Arad

ageRules.note: Child discount stops at 13. Children's tickets restricted to Peluza Sud, sector R.

procedure.home: iabilet.ro via uta-arad.ro, opening approx 4 days ahead. Also Fan Shop at the Arena (typically Tue/Thu/Fri 15:00-18:00) and the matchday box office a few hours before kick-off.
procedure.pricing: Tribuna 1 90 lei, Tribuna 2 70 lei, peluze 50 lei.

clubs.context: Built by Baron Neuman in 1946, modelled on Arsenal's old Highbury.

procedure.home: UNVERIFIED. Small Liga 2 club; gate sales near certain. Announcements via Facebook rather than a portal.

ageRules.accountHolder: unknown - VERIFY before the sale window
ageRules.note: Nominative tickets, name must match ID. No name changes for the derby - each ticket bought in the name of the person using it. This makes the account-holder question critical, not cosmetic.

phases: Phase 1 - OPEN TO EVERYONE WORLDWIDE, primo anello rosso/arancio only. The route from abroad.
Phase 2 - season ticket holders, secondo anello blu
Phase 3 - SiamoNoi cardholders, up to 4 tickets
procedure.warning: In 2025 the allocation sold out after phase 2, so the SiamoNoi phase never opened. The free card gates the LAST phase - it is not a shortcut. Phase 1 is the real route.
procedure.note: Secondo anello blu is the Milan away sector, excluded from that season ticket.
procedure.pricing: Third tier approx EUR 70-75; primo rosso centrale up to EUR 230.

clubs.name: AC Milan

ageRules.note: Nominative, no name change for the derby.

procedure.action: Register and obtain the Cuore Rossonero card WELL before the sale - cards have a cutoff days before the phase opens.

clubs.stadiumNote: New stadium targeted Dec 2030; demolition tender Oct 2030-Mar 2031, partial demolition to May 2032. No urgency.

clubs.name: RC Strasbourg Alsace

ageRules.idAtGate: Some French tickets are personalised. Carry ID.

procedure.ordinary: From approx EUR 20 on the official billetterie, opening approx 1 month ahead. Gates 2h30 before.
procedure.bigMatches: 'Prestige' (PSG, Marseille, Monaco) and 'Gala' (historically Lyon, Metz, Saint-Étienne) are NOT sold as single tickets to non-subscribers - only as TWO-MATCH PACKS, max 2 places, approx 1 month before the first of the pair.
procedure.resale: Official resale is the realistic route for sold-out matches. Only abonnés can list; anyone can buy; club sets prices. Opens 3-5 days before, usually WEDNESDAY.
procedure.warning: Club states its billetterie is the only valid channel. Never Viagogo or StubHub.

clubs.caveat: The pack rule is historical policy. The Meinau renovation completes with 2026/27, so allocation may have loosened. Verify.
clubs.bonus: Women's team plays at the Meinau in the Arkema Première Ligue including v PSG. Cheaper, no pack system - closes the women's-football gap.
clubs.travel: Direct train to Strasbourg, tram A to Lycée Couffignal.

clubs.name: Germany (DFB)
clubs.memberStatus: Fan Club Nationalmannschaft member, in own name

ageRules.note: CONTRADICTS the imported document, which claims DFB tickets must go through an adult's account. The user holds the membership himself and already secured the Sept/Oct 2026 tickets. Document is wrong here.

procedure.home: Fan Club presale via the DFB portal. Cheap fan-block tickets exist but go early. Membership also gives exclusive events and fan-tent access at home internationals.
procedure.away: Separate application window per fixture, typically closing weeks ahead.
procedure.autographs: Open training at adidas Home Ground Herzogenaurach - not every camp, free ticketed, approx 4,000 places, gone within an hour. Tournament base camps are the softest target.

clubs.name: UEFA (finals)

ageRules.accountHolder: DISPUTED - the imported document claims applicants must be 18+, which would mean the father applies and the user is named on the ticket. Not independently confirmed. THIS IS THE HIGHEST-PRIORITY THING TO VERIFY, before Feb 2027.

procedure.ballot: Public application at UEFA.com/tickets, approx 5 days, allocated by RANDOM DRAW after close - day one gives no advantage. Free to enter.
procedure.timing: 2026 precedent: general sales opened 16 March, Europa League deadline 11:00 CET 20 March. Document claims February. Alert late Feb, expect mid-March.
procedure.pricing: 2026 finals ran EUR 40-240. Each finalist received approx 12,000.
procedure.warning: Resellers charge many times face value and UEFA voids tickets bought outside official channels.

clubs.realism: The 2026 Europa League final in Istanbul drew 37,324 - it did not sell out. Odds better than for a Champions League final.

bucketList.title: Der Klassiker - Borussia Dortmund v Bayern, away end
bucketList.why: Stated top priority. Hardest single ticket in German football. Marked as a rivalry rather than a true local derby.
bucketList.blockedReason: The 2026/27 away request window closed 27 July 2026 with no request submitted. Away fixtures cannot be resold on the club site.
bucketList.unblockCondition: Enter the 2027/28 window, expected late July 2027. Request EVERY away fixture in one sitting - unsuccessful requests cost nothing.
bucketList.whyAssistant: Germany's top fixture: Bayern's tifo-heavy Südkurve in Munich, and Dortmund's standing Südtribüne in Dortmund.

bucketList.title: Politehnica Timișoara v UTA Arad - Derby-ul Vestului
bucketList.why: Stated as the single most personally invested derby in world football. Two former champions from neighbouring western cities, both wrecked by insolvency, both with supports far above their current level.
bucketList.blockedReason: Two obstacles. UTA are Superliga, Poli Liga 2 - no league fixture. And although both are in Cupa României Group A, the format gives each club three matches, one per seeding pot, and Poli's pot-one opponent is Rapid.
unblockCondition: Poli promotion - play-off decided approx mid-May 2027, giving two league meetings from 2027/28.
Both reaching the quarter-finals on 3 Mar 2027 AND same-group pairings being permitted - rule unverified.
bucketList.warning: 3 Mar 2027 is a Wednesday in German term time.
bucketList.whyAssistant: West Romania derby, with Arad's new stadium against Timișoara's large Dan Păltinișanu and its ultra following.

bucketList.title: UEFA Europa League final
bucketList.why: First genuine final above national-cup level. Two hours away, inside the Whitsun holidays (18-29 May 2027). The cheapest European final he will ever have access to.
bucketList.practical: Wednesday, 21:00 kick-off ending near 23:00. Overnight or no realistic train home.
bucketList.whyAssistant: One match in May at a rotating venue, with much better odds of a ticket than the Champions League final.

bucketList.title: Frankenderby - 1. FC Nürnberg v Greuther Fürth
bucketList.why: Neighbouring cities, over a century of open contempt, treated by police as one of Germany's highest-risk fixtures regardless of division. Biggest occasion reachable within 300 km.

bucketList.title: Liga 2 promotion play-off, decisive round

bucketList.title: Bundesliga Relegation, second leg
bucketList.why: The most nervous football in Germany.

trigger.action: Participants unknown until the final matchday. Check the morning after the last round.

bucketList.whyAssistant: Two-legged tie between the 16th-placed Bundesliga club and the 3rd-placed 2. Bundesliga club: the aggregate decides, there is no away-goals rule, and extra time and penalties follow if it is level. One top-flight place is at stake. In 2026 the first leg ended 0:0 and Paderborn beat Wolfsburg 2:1 after extra time in the return leg. The two sources agree on the format; the play-offs have been two-legged since 2008/09.

bucketList.title: Eternal Derby - Red Star v Partizan
bucketList.why: Rated the best pyrotechnic display in world football, in a stadium where the noise is constant for ninety minutes.
bucketList.deferReason: Stadium safety culture well below German standards. Flagged in the source as an item for 17-18+, with a neutral section and no colours. Not a next-season entry.
bucketList.whyAssistant: The Belgrade "Eternal Derby", among Europe's loudest atmospheres.

bucketList.title: Intercontinental Derby - Galatasaray v Fenerbahçe
bucketList.why: Rated the most intimidating atmosphere in European football. Frequently played with away fans banned.
bucketList.deferReason: Same category as Belgrade. Older item.
bucketList.whyAssistant: One of the loudest derbies anywhere, split between Europe and Asia. Away fans are often banned.

bucketList.title: Old Firm - Celtic v Rangers
bucketList.why: Rated the most tribal fixture in Europe.
bucketList.deferReason: Effectively unavailable to anyone who is not a season-ticket holder at one of the two clubs. A European night at Celtic Park is the achievable version of the same ground.
bucketList.whyAssistant: A unique atmosphere with deep historical baggage. Away allocations vary.

bucketList.title: Derby of the Eternal Enemies - Olympiacos v Panathinaikos
bucketList.why: Working-class Piraeus against establishment Athens. One of the most hostile environments in Europe.
bucketList.relatedNear: PAOK at Toumba - already came close once and missed by finding out late.
bucketList.whyAssistant: Athens' biggest rivalry. Away fans are often not allowed, so tickets can be hard for outsiders.

bucketList.title: Eternul derby - FCSB v Dinamo București

bucketList.ticketNote: ID-named and sells out. Heaviest policing and segregation in Romanian football.

bucketList.whyAssistant: Bucharest's biggest fixture. Venues vary and are unverified.

bucketList.whyAssistant: East German rivalry between two large supporter bases, with heavy security around it.

bucketList.title: UEFA Nations League Finals 2027

bucketList.title: 2. Bundesliga relegation play-off against the 3. Liga

trigger.playedMonthStatus: inferred - observed in the 2026 play-off only (22 and 26 May)

bucketList.whyAssistant: Two-legged tie between the 16th-placed 2. Bundesliga club and the 3rd-placed 3. Liga club, decided on aggregate with no away-goals rule, then extra time and penalties. The winner plays in the 2. Bundesliga next season, the loser in the 3. Liga. In 2026 the third-tier club hosted the first leg because its last matchday came a day earlier; Essen won it 1:0 and Fürth won the return 2:0 at home to stay up. The participants are unknown until the last matchday.

bucketList.title: Aufstiegsspiele zur 3. Liga (Regionalliga champions' play-off)
bucketList.whyAssistant: Not a 3. Liga club against a Regionalliga club: two Regionalliga champions play home and away for the last promotion place to the 3. Liga, while the other promotion places go to champions directly. The sources describe the model as two direct places (West, Südwest), one rotating direct place for Nord, Nordost or Bayern, and a two-legged play-off between the other two champions. A reform vote in June 2026 produced no clear result and the sources put any change at 2028/29 at the earliest, so the current model is expected to apply in 2026/27 - not confirmed by a DFB statement. Which two champions meet is unknown until the Regionalliga seasons end. In 2026 Würzburger Kickers beat Lok Leipzig in this play-off (the sources give the first leg as 1:0 and the second as 2:1 in Würzburg's favour).

bucketList.title: Superliga relegation play-off against Liga 2

trigger.playedMonthStatus: inferred - observed in the 2025-26 play-offs only (first legs around 23 May, return legs up to 1 June)

bucketList.whyAssistant: In 2025-26 the two Superliga clubs just above the directly relegated 15th and 16th places each met one of the top Liga 2 clubs (the third and fourth placed) in a two-legged tie. In 2026 Farul Constanța drew 3-3 and 1-1 with Chindia Târgoviște and stayed up on penalties; FC Voluntari lost 2-3 at Hermannstadt, then won 3-0 at home and went up. Which clubs meet is unknown until the end of the play-out. The 2026-27 competition rules were not found, so the format may change.

bucketList.title: Liga 3 promotion tournament for the last Liga 2 place

trigger.playedMonthStatus: inferred - observed in the 2025-26 cycle only (final scheduled for 6 June 2026)

bucketList.whyAssistant: Not a match between Liga 2 and Liga 3 clubs: the runners-up of the Liga 3 play-off groups play single-match semi-finals and a final, with the first semi-final's winner hosting the final, and the winner takes the fifth promotion place to Liga 2. The group winners go up directly. The 2025-26 rules are from the federation's competition system and press; older editions used a different, two-legged format, and the 2026-27 rules were not found. Liga 2's own relegation play-off is between Liga 2 clubs only and is not covered here.
